# Sanjiv Gupta CPA Firm

> > A Bay Area CPA firm specializing in business and personal tax services, FBAR compliance, and tax planning for Indian Americans and non-resident Indians.

Sanjiv Gupta CPA Firm provides comprehensive tax and accounting services with offices across the San Francisco Bay Area including Fremont, Pleasanton, Sunnyvale, and Tracy. The firm specializes in foreign account reporting, FBAR filing, and tax strategies for expats and international business owners.

## Key Topics

- FBAR filing
- Foreign account reporting
- FinCEN Form 114
- Form 8938
- Business taxes
- Personal taxes
- Tax compliance
- NRI services
- Expat taxes
- Foreign bank accounts
- Tax deadlines
- FBAR penalties
- IRS regulations
- Tax consultation
- Sanjiv Gupta CPA
